Nasogastric tube. Insertion, care and removal, step by step.

Step one. Know why the tube is needed: decompression, drainage, medicines, or feeding. Choose a short or long term tube, sized for the patient's age and purpose. Take extra care with infants, children and older people.
Step two. Prepare. Verify the physician's order. Explain the procedure, including the discomfort to expect. Make sure suction and airway equipment are at the bedside.
Step three. Measure the tube from the nose tip, to the earlobe, to the xiphisternum. Mark this length on the tube.
Step four. Lubricate the tip and advance gently, asking the patient to swallow. Stop if there is distress, coughing, or cyanosis. Tape the tube temporarily.

Step five. Critical point. Confirm placement. Aspirate half to one millilitre and test it on a pH indicator strip. A safe reading is between zero point five and five. If it is out of range, do not use the tube.
Step six. Critical point. Never use the whoosh test, litmus paper, or watching for bubbles. They cannot tell the stomach from the lung.
Step seven. Critical point. Straight after the X-ray confirms position, mark the tube at the nostril, and record the centimetre marking.
Step eight. Secure the tube as per the procedural manual, with no pressure on the nostril.

Step nine. Before every feed or medicine, check the mark has not moved. For continuous feeds, check every four to six hours. Stop the feed for thirty to sixty minutes, flush twenty millilitres of air, aspirate, and test the pH.
Step ten. Ongoing care. If you cannot aspirate, follow the procedural manual. Give oral and nasal care, and replace the tube as the manufacturer advises.
Step eleven. To remove the tube, explain the reason first, then pull smoothly and steadily, and observe the patient afterwards.
Step twelve. Reassure the patient, respect their dignity and privacy, and escalate any concern about placement promptly.
Step thirteen. Document after insertion and after removal, and hand over the marking length every shift.
Watch, take the quiz, then get signed off.
